name: Reveal line
description: A line people move across the table: on one side of it the layers placed inside it show, such as what lies under the ground

about.purpose: Compares two states with a line people drag across the table: layers inside it show on one side.
questions: What changes between today and the proposal?
What lies under the ground here?
limits: Shows layers placed inside it; it does not compute anything itself

options.label: Side to side, moved up and down
Left of the line, or above it
Right of the line, or below it

controls.label: With two layers inside, the second shows on the other side
Hide the map where they show
The line sweeps slowly while nobody moves it
